Request for Proposals (“RFP”) for Audit Services for the Indiana Public Retirement System (“INPRS” or the “System”)

INPRS is soliciting proposals from all qualified providers who wish to be considered in providing Audit Services, as described in Section 3 – Scope of Services.", "key_items": ["1.1 Title", "1.2 Overview of Request for Audit Services"]}, {"title": "1.3 INPRS Background", "node_id": "0003", "start_index": 3, "end_index": 4, "summary": "INPRS was established by Indiana statute in 2011 as an independent body corporate and politic—not a state department or agency—to manage public-employee retirement funds. It administers 16 funds across defined-benefit plans (PERF, TRF, police/fire, judges, excise/gaming/conservation officers, prosecutors and legislators), defined-contribution plans (PERF, TRF and legislators), other postemployment benefits (Special Death Benefit and Retirement Medical Benefits), and a custodial fund (Local Public Safety Pension Relief).
